Frequently Asked Questions
- I can't use my weapon set passive points, why?
You first need normal passive points before you can split them with the weapon set points. So to apply the max 24 weapon points for each set, you first need 24 normal passive points available to use
- How come I can't summon 's each time I swap weapons?
When one of our 's die, it start the minion respawn timer. Normally takes up to 8-11 seconds before they can spawn again. When outside combat, weapon swapping bypasses this timer, and always spawns your minions instantly. When in-combat however, you need to wait for this timer to run out first or use  to resummon them a limited number of extra times
- My minions have a X MINUTE respawn timer?!
This happens due to the game letting you have more minions selected than your spirit allows. Make sure to press the - (minus) button to reduce the amount of minions you have until the + (plus) lights up, and click that once
- Why aren't my 's summoned when I swap to set 2?
First thing to check is the skill gem section of the current variant you are playing. Each skill should only be active on one of the two sets.  requires that you specifically set the amount summoned per set. Put it at the max possible for set 2, and none for set 1. This is all done in the skill specific stat window. First access skill gem menu (default G), then click the small arrow on the right side next to the DPS number for a particular skill and then on the menu that appears bottom right checkboxes. Refer to Dual Specialisation gem section
- Why is my  doing so little damage?
The higher the level of , the significantly more damage it can deal. Focus this over other intelligence spirit gems early
- How come  is dying constantly to ?

This build revolves around the  skill that gets cast every time you take a step with  boots equipped. It automatically targets dead enemies around you (corpses), consuming them to create poison clouds that slowly expand. It deals pseudo-hit chaos damage poison based on the life of that enemy before it died, meaning it scales with monster HP and level.
 allows  to trigger on our own undead minions (), meaning we can spawn poison clouds without needing to kill something first. Thus  will do more damage the more life the  has.
To spawn 's to create poison clouds when we need them, we use weapon swapping. This way we can have all our de-buffs and buffs active on Set 1, minions and  active on Set 2, thus effectively doubling our usable spirit. So when we swap to Set 2 our minions instantly spawn next to us and  targets them as we step.
Each  targeted by  will spawn it's own poison cloud. Each cloud applies one poison per 2 seconds up to a maximum poison capacity. With , , 2x  and  our maximum poison capacity becomes 10. More poison clouds = more poisons per second, NOT more damage. It just means you reach the poison capacity faster, and stay at max longer.
When one of our 's die, it will start the minion respawn timer. Normally it can take 10-16 seconds before they can spawn naturally again. When outside combat, weapon swapping bypasses this timer, and always spawns your minions instantly. When in-combat however, you usually have to wait, luckily  can ressurrect your minions. You can keep casting it until you don't summon any more minions before swapping back to Set 1.  clouds last long enough that you don't need to resummon minions often anyway.
During maps, we don't want to wait for this timer before we can spawn clouds, so we use  instead for killing packs of monsters. As long as a couple monsters survive,  will target the corpses of stuff we kill and poison those remaining monsters. This refills our  instantly meaning we can use it again for the next pack of monsters. When casting , make sure to hit several packs of monsters, we don't want to kill everything with one cast.  clouds should clean up stragglers.
 will only gather poison when using Set 1. Make sure to stay in Set 1 whenever possible, as our de-buffs such as  with  and  are only active when that set is equipped.

Frequently Asked Questions

- I can't use my weapon set passive points, why?

You first need normal passive points before you can split them with the weapon set points. So to apply the max 24 weapon points for each set, you first need 24 normal passive points available to use

- How come I can't summon 
Bind Spectre
's each time I swap weapons?

When one of our 
Bind Spectre
's die, it start the minion respawn timer. Normally takes up to 8-11 seconds before they can spawn again. When outside combat, weapon swapping bypasses this timer, and always spawns your minions instantly. When in-combat however, you need to wait for this timer to run out first or use 
Grim Feast
 to resummon them a limited number of extra times

- My minions have a X MINUTE respawn timer?!

This happens due to the game letting you have more minions selected than your spirit allows. Make sure to press the - (minus) button to reduce the amount of minions you have until the + (plus) lights up, and click that once

- Why aren't my 
Bind Spectre
's summoned when I swap to set 2?

First thing to check is the skill gem section of the current variant you are playing. Each skill should only be active on one of the two sets. 
Bind Spectre
 requires that you specifically set the amount summoned per set. Put it at the max possible for set 2, and none for set 1. This is all done in the skill specific stat window. First access skill gem menu (default G), then click the small arrow on the right side next to the DPS number for a particular skill and then on the menu that appears bottom right checkboxes. Refer to Dual Specialisation gem section

- Why is my 
Plague Bearer
 doing so little damage?

The higher the level of 
Plague Bearer
, the significantly more damage it can deal. Focus this over other intelligence spirit gems early

Skeletal Sniper
 is dying constantly to

?

How it Works

This build revolves around the 
Decompose
 skill that gets cast every time you take a step with 
Corpsewade
 boots equipped. It automatically targets dead enemies around you (corpses), consuming them to create poison clouds that slowly expand. It deals pseudo-hit chaos damage poison based on the life of that enemy before it died, meaning it scales with monster HP and level.

Sacrifice
 allows 
Decompose
 to trigger on our own undead minions (
Bind Spectre
), meaning we can spawn poison clouds without needing to kill something first. Thus 
Decompose
 will do more damage the more life the 
Bind Spectre
 has.

To spawn 
Bind Spectre
's to create poison clouds when we need them, we use weapon swapping. This way we can have all our de-buffs and buffs active on Set 1, minions and 
Sacrifice
 active on Set 2, thus effectively doubling our usable spirit. So when we swap to Set 2 our minions instantly spawn next to us and 
Decompose
 targets them as we step.

Each 
Bind Spectre
 targeted by 
Decompose
 will spawn it's own poison cloud. Each cloud applies one poison per 2 seconds up to a maximum poison capacity. With 
Stacking Toxins
, 
Building Toxins
, 2x 
Talisman of Thruldana
 and 
Overwhelming Toxicity
 our maximum poison capacity becomes 10. More poison clouds = more poisons per second, NOT more damage. It just means you reach the poison capacity faster, and stay at max longer.

When one of our 
Bind Spectre
's die, it will start the minion respawn timer. Normally it can take 10-16 seconds before they can spawn naturally again. When outside combat, weapon swapping bypasses this timer, and always spawns your minions instantly. When in-combat however, you usually have to wait, luckily 
Grim Feast
 can ressurrect your minions. You can keep casting it until you don't summon any more minions before swapping back to Set 1. 
Decompose
 clouds last long enough that you don't need to resummon minions often anyway.

During maps, we don't want to wait for this timer before we can spawn clouds, so we use 
Plague Bearer
 instead for killing packs of monsters. As long as a couple monsters survive, 
Decompose
 will target the corpses of stuff we kill and poison those remaining monsters. This refills our 
Plague Bearer
 instantly meaning we can use it again for the next pack of monsters. When casting 
Plague Bearer
, make sure to hit several packs of monsters, we don't want to kill everything with one cast. 
Decompose
 clouds should clean up stragglers.

Plague Bearer
 will only gather poison when using Set 1. Make sure to stay in Set 1 whenever possible, as our de-buffs such as 
Blasphemy
 with 
Temporal Chains
 and 
Despair
 are only active when that set is equipped.
